title: Port Forge Conductor 0.9.0 to a native Windows 11 Forsetti application
initiating_request: Create a comprehensive fail-forward autonomous Windows 11 port with installer, strict object-oriented C++20, native Windows technologies, Forsetti compliance, feature parity, no Python, and no automated-authorship attribution.
objective: Deliver an installable, native Windows 11 Forge Conductor with complete macOS feature parity, autonomous project memory and continuity, bounded resource use, and independently validated release artifacts.
business_reason: Provide a reliable Windows-native orchestration application for local models and agentic workflows while preserving Forsetti architecture and operation on machines with varied memory capacity.

in_scope: native C++20 domain, application, infrastructure, CLI, manager, MCP, session host, installer, tests, and WinUI 3 UI
out_of_scope: modifying ForsettiCore, ForsettiPlatform, or ForsettiHostTemplate internals
adding Python to the Windows product
GUI automation of LM Studio or another model host
removing or stubbing current Forge Conductor features

required_outputs: native GUI, CLI, manager, MCP server, and session-host plugin
MSIX bundle, App Installer descriptor, and native setup bootstrapper

documentation_impact.rationale: A new platform edition and installer require complete product, architecture, setup, security, migration, and operational documentation.

validation_requirements: all 53 MCP tools pass contract tests
project memory and continuity pass multi-project and crash-recovery tests
evidence_requirements: command logs with exit codes and hashes
constraints: no operator intervention during implementation and validation
risks: host APIs may not create GUI chats
GPU counter availability varies by driver
release signing secrets may be unavailable
escalation_triggers: owner requirements directly contradict a Forsetti constitutional invariant
a required Microsoft SDK is legally unavailable
definition_of_done: every parity row is passed with evidence
installer installs and launches on a clean Windows 11 user profile
autonomous continuity creates and resumes a successor logical session
resource budgets pass on the constrained profile
all release artifacts and documentation are present
